items.question: Is this free to use?
items.answer: Yes — the CLI and all blocks are free and open source under the MIT license. Use them for personal and commercial projects.

items.question: Can I use this for commercial projects?
items.answer: Absolutely. The MIT license allows unlimited commercial use with no attribution required.

items.question: How do I switch between themes?
items.answer: Run the CLI and pick a palette during setup, or edit the CSS variables in your global stylesheet at any time.

items.question: Does it work with React components?
items.answer: Blocks are pure Astro by design, but you can add React islands alongside them using Astro's built-in framework integration.

items.question: Where can I deploy?
items.answer: Anywhere that supports Astro — Cloudflare Workers (recommended), Vercel, Netlify, or any static host.
